name: etoro-mcp-server
description: Unofficial MCP server for the eToro Public API: read your portfolio and market data, and opt in to preparing orders that you review and execute yourself on a local approval page.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your own eToro account through the eToro Public API.

**Read-only and demo by default.** Placing, closing and cancelling orders must be switched on explicitly, Claude can only prepare an action (eligibility, cost estimate, size caps): you execute it yourself on a local page that opens in your browser, and real-money writes need a second opt-in. API keys are stored in your operating system's keychain and never leave your machine except in requests to eToro.

This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by eToro. It is not financial advice. Trading, especially with leverage or CFDs, can lose money.

user_key.title: eToro user key
user_key.description: Your eToro user key (x-user-key), from the same key pair.

use_real.title: Use the REAL environment
use_real.description: Off = eToro's demo environment (virtual money). On = your real account. The key pair must have been created for the same environment.

enable_write.title: Enable write tools
enable_write.description: Off by default (read-only). When on, Claude can prepare orders, closes, cancellations and watchlist changes; you execute each one on a local approval page. Requires a key with Write permission.

allow_real_write.title: Allow writes on the REAL environment
allow_real_write.description: Second opt-in required before write tools exist on a real-money account. Ignored in demo.

allow_transfers.title: Allow internal transfers (real only)
allow_transfers.description: Registers a tool that can move funds between your own eToro accounts. Needs both write switches. Leave off unless you need it.

max_order_usd.title: Max exposure per order (USD)
max_order_usd.description: Largest order the server will preview. Exposure = amount x leverage.

max_session_usd.title: Max total exposure per session (USD)
max_session_usd.description: Total exposure the server will execute until it is restarted.

max_daily_usd.title: Max total exposure per day (USD)
max_daily_usd.description: Total exposure the server will execute per calendar day and environment. Counted across every server process and restarts.

max_daily_writes.title: Max actions executed per day
max_daily_writes.description: Orders, closes, stop-loss changes and other writes the server will execute per calendar day and environment.

timezone.title: Time zone for the daily limits and the history page
timezone.description: IANA name, for example America/Santiago. A new day starts at midnight in this zone. Default: UTC.
